messages:
maria (SRE): incident-bot alerted for spike in 5xxs - gateway errors and timeouts starting ~4019876500.
incident-bot: ALERT: 5xx rate > threshold on /v1/generate across us-east-1 (alert_id=INC-2026-142). Paging oncall.
alisa (oncall): taking this. seeing 502/504s and a lot of client-side timeouts. dashboards show p95 token latency spiking and retries. any deploys in last 30m?
maria (SRE): no prod deploys flagged. there was a config change to prefetch TTLs ~40m ago (infra job) but ops says it shouldn't trigger 5xx. logs show lots of prefix_cache checksum mismatch warnings.
sam (infra): looking at cache hosts, many prefix-kv workers reporting eviction storms and a backlog of read requests. some shards at 100% CPU and high GC.
jong (eng-runtime): logs from the gateway show repeated backend 502s caused by upstream 5xx. stack traces pointing to exception when applying prefix lookup: `ErrInvalidPrefixChecksum`. sample snippet: ```
[2026-03-12T14:02:10Z] prefix_cache.go:482 prefix=customer/1234 checksum_mismatch=true err=ErrInvalidPrefixChecksum
[2026-03-12T14:02:10Z] runtime/serve.go:210 upstream=kv-shard-7 status=502
```
alisa (oncall): big picture: prefix cache corruption -> many reads hit fallback path -> thundering prefetch/paging -> timeouts and 502s. impact: ~12% of requests failing, major customers affected intermittently.
maria (SRE): confirming customer TPS drop on routes that use prefix caching heavily (embeddings and multi-turn chat). customer-success reported degraded experience for 3 enterprise accounts.
sam (infra): mitigation proposal: 1) disable prefetch on affected pool (us-east-1-prefetch=false), 2) flip routing to bypass prefix-cache for suspect model routes (route-level policy), 3) scale up kv-shard replicas and restart corrupted workers slowly.
jong (eng-runtime): we can push a routing override via feature toggle: `routing.prefix_cache.enabled=false` for the pool. that should route calls to read-through path and avoid the corrupt cached entries. downside: increased latency and cost.
alisa (oncall): do it. execute plan and monitor errors. escalate if customer error >20% or p50 > 3s.
incident-bot: ACTION: toggled feature flag routing.prefix_cache.enabled=false for cluster us-east-1 at 4019876602 by alisa.
sam (infra): started staggered restarts of kv-prefetch workers on shard group alpha. rolling restarts to avoid mass eviction. commands used: ```
for h in $(cat shard-alpha-hosts); do ssh $h 'sudo systemctl restart kv-prefetch'; sleep 8; done
```
maria (SRE): after toggle we're seeing 5xx rate drop to ~5% and gateway timeouts falling. some residual latency as read-through warms. p95 improved after first restart.
jong (eng-runtime): added temporary auto-fallback to smaller model variant for latency-sensitive routes to reduce load on KV. route override: `model.fallback=redwood-small-v2` applied at 4019876675.
alisa (oncall): customer-impact update: 3 customers had visible errors in last 15m, CS team notified and running targeted retries. we should prepare incident page and postmortem. can someone create ticket?
maria (SRE): creating INC-2026-142 in tracker with initial notes and mitigating actions. assigning to eng-runtime + infra for debug and RCA. estimated severity: sev2.
sam (infra): root cause analysis in-flight: hypothesis: recent prefetch TTL change combined with cache compaction bug caused index rotation to expose stale checksum metadata -> corruption during eviction storm. collecting heap/metrics and checksums for comparison.
jong (eng-runtime): also attaching gateway traces and KV debug logs to the ticket. recommend we add a schema/compatibility check on prefix metadata during apply to fail-safe rather than throw 5xx.
alisa (oncall): immediate followups: - keep prefix cache disabled for us-east-1 until patch deploy - complete controlled restart of all prefetch workers by 4019877300 - CS comms: short status update in 15m - if rollback needed, prepare config rollback for TTL change.
maria (SRE): confirming. scheduling handoff to night oncall at 4019876800. alisa -> jong for next 2hr watch.
customer-success: notified three accounts (acct-ACME, acct-BETA, acct-OMEGA). suggested workaround: clients can increase request timeouts and enable retries; we can enable per-customer routing to unaffected pools if needed.
incident-bot: NOTES: mitigation reduced errors. please add post-incident blameless RCA and tag `kv-prefix-cache` and `eviction-storm`.
jong (eng-runtime): quick diagnostic output attached: ```
# counts by error
ErrInvalidPrefixChecksum: 4821
EvictionBackpressure: 32000
ReadThroughFallback: 19876
```
alisa (oncall): handing off now to jong for continued monitoring and RCA. if error rate rises >8% re-page. thanks team :thumbsup:
jong (eng-runtime): taking over. will coordinate patch for checksum-compatibility and schedule full restart window. logging next update in ticket.
